create.descriptionGuide:
Essential structure of a good job posting:

1. Job title (direct and clear)
Use the exact name of the occupation the candidate is looking for. Do not invent terms.
• Correct examples: Cashier, Shelf Stocker, Warehouse Assistant.

2. Company and location summary
In two lines, explain what the company does and, most importantly, where the workplace is (neighborhood or area). Living nearby is a deciding factor for operational workers.
• Example: "We are a growing supermarket chain and we are hiring for our new store in the Santana neighborhood."

3. What will you do day to day? (Responsibilities)
Use short sentences and action verbs. Be realistic about physical effort and the routine.
• Example for a shelf stocker:
	• Receive and check goods in the stockroom.
	• Restock the shelves.
	• Check expiration dates and organize products by date.
	• Keep the aisle clean and organized for customers.

4. What do you need? (Basic requirements)
Do not demand long experience or complex courses unless they are strictly necessary. Focus on the essentials.
• Common examples:
	• High school completed or in progress.
	• Availability for a retail schedule (6 days on, 1 day off).
	• Ease working with the public (cashier or attendant).
	• Physical stamina to move boxes (stocker or warehouse).
	• Prior experience is a plus, but not required (we train on site).

5. Desirable, but not a knockout
- Completed schooling or a technical course, depending on the role
- Distance from the workplace
- Length of experience, which may state a desired minimum

6. Schedule and shift
• How to write it: Make the shifts very clear. Operational workers need to plan their commute.
• Example: "6x1 schedule (one day off per week). Hours: 2:00 p.m. to 10:00 p.m."

7. Pay and benefits (the main attraction)
Postings without pay or a benefits list lose many candidates in this category. Be transparent.
• Example:
	• Pay: R$ X,XXX.XX plus cashier allowance, if applicable.
	• Transport voucher.
	• Meal voucher or on-site cafeteria.
	• Medical and dental assistance.
	• Store purchase discount.

setupSteps: Create an OIDC application in your identity provider (Okta, Azure AD, Google Workspace, etc.).
Copy the Client ID and Client Secret from your IdP and paste them above.
Enter the Issuer URL — The system will auto-discover all OIDC endpoints.
howItWorks: You register your company's identity provider (IdP) — Okta, Azure AD, Google Workspace, or any OIDC-compliant provider.
Team members visit the sign-in page and enter their work email. The system detects the email domain and redirects to your IdP.
After authenticating with the IdP, users are automatically provisioned into your organization as members — no invitation needed.
